card.name: Counts and scope in descriptive facts
card.fires_on: Words ending a number, quantity or place phrase in general-web factual statements, such as institutes in Germany, more than forty, 6 million visits, or young people from across the world. It comes just before words like annually or per year.

modes.label: Quantity phrases
modes.description: A number or the counted noun right after it, in statistics about an organization.
modes.example: It employs about 325<< people>> and is located at the Max Planck

modes.label: Scope or place phrases
modes.description: A word closing a place or time scope, where a yearly or nationwide qualifier could follow.
modes.example: The Max Planck Institute for Developmental Biology is one of 80 research institutes that the Max Planck Society for the Advancement of Science maintains<< in>> Germany.

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning annually, per year, estimated or nationwide, in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It fires on counts and scope in factual descriptions, where a phrase like 'each year' might come next.
